lede: The school board votes Monday on a flood-related budget appropriation for the coming school year — real money tied to real damage at TIS, TMHS, and the Palm Theatre complex — and that alone is worth tracking. Alongside it, the Ethics Commission takes up a formal Code of Conduct recommendation for Town officials on Tuesday, the county weighs child-care funding implications on Wednesday, and the Hospital District board considers a Two Site Model that could define what gets built and where for years to come.

notable.stake: Board votes on flood-damage budget appropriation affecting district spending this year.
Commission recommends whether Town officials get a binding Code of Conduct.
County weighs CCAP child-care funding and its budget impact on Human Services.
Hospital board may act on Two Site Model, shaping scope and location of new facility.
TMVOA votes on workforce housing committee formation and updated association policies.
